title: Conservation of cis -regulatory codes over half a billion years of evolution
authors: Ogawa Y; Liu Y; Myers CA; Morshedian A; Fain GL; Sampath AP; Corbo JC
one_liner_zh: 该文通过跨物种单细胞染色质可及性分析，研究视网膜细胞类型中顺式调控代码的保守性，涉及TF结合位点聚类与机器学习建模，但核心是调控元件进化而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上机器学习应用较浅。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

The identification of homologous cell types across species represents a crucial step in understanding cell type evolution. The retina is particularly amenable to comparative analysis because the basic morphology, connectivity, and function of its six major cell classes have remained largely invariant since the earliest stages of vertebrate evolution. Here, we show that the retina’s highly conserved cellular architecture is mirrored by deep conservation of the underlying cis -regulatory codes that control gene expression. We use comparative single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis of lamprey, fish, bird, and mammalian retinas— representing over half a billion years of evolutionary divergence—to demonstrate cross-species conservation of cis -regulatory codes in all six retinal cell classes. This conservation persists despite extensive turnover of cis -regulatory regions between distant species. Conservation manifests as the clustering of multiple distinct high-affinity transcription factor (TF) binding sites toward the center of cell-class-specific open chromatin regions with little cross-species preservation of higher-order syntax. Hierarchical clustering of machine-learning models of retinal cis -regulatory codes from diverse species recovers six clusters corresponding to the six retinal cell classes. Thus, the retina’s cellular Bauplan is controlled by cis -regulatory codes which predate the divergence of extant vertebrates and persist despite nearly complete enhancer turnover.
abstract_zh:
摘要

跨物种同源细胞类型的鉴定是理解细胞类型进化的关键步骤。视网膜特别适合进行比较分析，因为其六种主要细胞类别的基本形态、连接性和功能自脊椎动物进化的最早阶段以来基本保持不变。在此，我们表明视网膜高度保守的细胞架构与其控制基因表达的下游顺式调控代码的深度保守性相呼应。我们利用七鳃鳗、鱼类、鸟类和哺乳动物视网膜的比较单细胞染色质可及性分析——代表超过五亿年的进化分歧——来证明所有六种视网膜细胞类别中顺式调控代码的跨物种保守性。尽管远缘物种间顺式调控区域发生广泛更替，这种保守性依然存在。保守性表现为多个不同的高亲和力转录因子（TF）结合位点向细胞类别特异性开放染色质区域中心聚集，而高阶语法几乎没有跨物种保留。对来自不同物种的视网膜顺式调控代码的机器学习模型进行层次聚类，恢复了与六种视网膜细胞类别对应的六个聚类。因此，视网膜的细胞蓝图由顺式调控代码控制，这些代码早于现存脊椎动物的分歧，并在增强子几乎完全更替的情况下依然持续存在。
